Definition: properly, conservative; but used passively, delivered
BiblicalUsage: Isaiah's Servant is raised up to restore the preserved of Israel and to be a light to the Gentiles, God's salvation to the end of the earth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the preserved are not forgotten: Israel's remnant is restored by the same Servant who lights the nations, and God's salvation reaches the ends of the earth through them.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
